int[][] points(int[] sizes)
    count := 1
    for size := sizes[]
        count *= size
    int[][] result := []
    for: ordinal < count
        point := array(#sizes, fill = 0)
        rest := ordinal
        dimension := int(#sizes) - 1
        while dimension >= 0
            point[dimension] = rest % sizes[dimension]
            rest /= sizes[dimension]
            dimension -= 1
        result = result.append(point)
    return result

string day_notation(bool[] days)
    string[] runs := []
    day := 1
    while day <= 365
        if not days[day]
            day += 1
            continue
        first := day
        while day < 365 and days[day + 1]
            day += 1
        runs = runs.append("{first}-{day}")
        day += 1
    return runs.join(",")

int blocker(int[] earlier, string[] standalone)
    for index := earlier[]
        if standalone[index] != "NOT_APPLICABLE"
            return index
    return -1

int conflict_winner(string algorithm, int earlier, int later, string first_effect)
    if algorithm == "first-applicable"
        return earlier
    effect := if algorithm == "deny-overrides" or algorithm == "permit-unless-deny" then "DENY" else "PERMIT"
    return if first_effect == effect then earlier else later

class Node(string operation, string text, int[] children)
class Tree(Node[] nodes, int root)
class Parser(string[] tokens)
    position := 0
    Node[] nodes := []

string[] tokenize(string text)
    string[] tokens := []
    i := 0
    while i < int(#text)
        c := text[i]
        if c == " "
            i += 1
            continue
        first := i
        if c == DQ
            i += 1
            while text[i] != DQ
                i += 1
            i += 1
        elif "0123456789".contains(c)
            i += 1
            while i < int(#text) and "0123456789".contains(text[i])
                i += 1
        elif "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(c)
            i += 1
            while i < int(#text) and "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_.".contains(text[i])
                i += 1
        else
            i += 1
            if i < int(#text) and text[i] == "=" and "=!<>".contains(c)
                i += 1
        tokens = tokens.append(text[first:<i])
    return tokens

string peek(Parser parser)
    return if parser.position < int(#parser.tokens) then parser.tokens[parser.position] else ""

string take(Parser &parser)
    result := parser.tokens[parser.position]
    parser.position += 1
    return result

int add(Parser &parser, string operation, string text, int[] children)
    index := int(#parser.nodes)
    parser.nodes = parser.nodes.append(Node(operation, text, children))
    return index

int precedence(string token)
    if token == "or"
        return 1
    if token == "and"
        return 2
    if token == "==" or token == "!=" or token == "<" or token == "<=" or token == ">" or token == ">=" or token == "in"
        return 4
    if token == "+" or token == "-"
        return 5
    return if token == "*" then 6 else 0

int parse_expression(Parser &parser, int minimum)
    token := take(&parser)
    left := -1
    if token == "not" or token == "-"
        child := parse_expression(&parser, if token == "not" then 3 else 7)
        left = add(&parser, token, "", [child])
    elif token == "("
        left = parse_expression(&parser, 1)
        closing := take(&parser)
    elif token == "["
        int[] children := []
        while peek(parser) != "]"
            value := take(&parser)
            children = children.append(add(&parser, "string", value[1:<int(#value) - 1], []))
            if peek(parser) != "]"
                separator := take(&parser)
        closing := take(&parser)
        left = add(&parser, "bag", "", children)
    elif token.starts_with(DQ)
        left = add(&parser, "string", token[1:<int(#token) - 1], [])
    elif "0123456789".contains(token[0])
        left = add(&parser, "integer", token, [])
    elif token == "true" or token == "false"
        left = add(&parser, "boolean", token, [])
    elif token == "it"
        left = add(&parser, "it", "", [])
    elif token.contains(".")
        left = add(&parser, "attribute", token, [])
    else
        opening := take(&parser)
        int[] children := []
        while peek(parser) != ")"
            children = children.append(parse_expression(&parser, 1))
            if peek(parser) != ")"
                separator := take(&parser)
        closing := take(&parser)
        left = add(&parser, token, "", children)
    while precedence(peek(parser)) >= minimum
        operation := take(&parser)
        right := parse_expression(&parser, precedence(operation) + 1)
        left = add(&parser, operation, "", [left, right])
    return left

Tree parse(string text)
    parser := Parser(tokenize(text))
    root := parse_expression(&parser, 1)
    return Tree(parser.nodes, root)

import collections
import rbac = "./rbac.qui"
import policy_parser = "./policy_parser.qui"
import expressions = "./expressions.qui"
import combining = "./combining.qui"
import analysis = "./analysis.qui"

class Value(string kind, integer := 0, text := "", boolean := false, string[] bag := [])
class Resource(string name, string kind, map<string, Value> attributes)
class Domain(string name, Value[] values)
class Request(string name, string user, string roles, string action, string resource, map<string, Value> environment_values, bool explain)
class Input()
    subjects := map<string, map<string, Value>>()
    Resource[] resources := []
    Domain[] domains := []
    reference := map<string, Value>()
    Request[] requests := []
class TargetResult(state := "MATCH", reason := "")
class Evaluation()
    state := 0
    target := TargetResult()
    condition := ""
    decision := combining.Decision()
    decisive := -1
    string[] obligations := []
    string[] advice := []
class Activation(string role, string reason)
class Checked()
    error_message := ""
    day := 0
    resource := -1
    Activation[] activations := []
    string[] roles := []
    granting := ""
    attributes := map<string, Value>()
    Evaluation[] evaluations := []
class Engine(rbac.RBAC roles_data, policy_parser.Element[] elements, Input inputs)
    string[] coverage := [for element := elements[] then ""]
    grants := map<(string, string, string), int>()
    decisions := map<string, int>()
    decisive := map<int, int>()
    obligations := map<string, int>()
    advice := map<string, int>()
    refused := 0
    string[] decision_lines := []
    string[] trace_lines := []

Value failure(string reason)
    return Value("error", text = reason)

Value boolean_value(bool value)
    return Value("boolean", boolean = value)

Value lookup(map<string, Value> attributes, string name)
    match attributes.get(name)
        Value value
            return value
        none
            return failure("missing " + name)

Value input_value(string text)
    if text == "true" or text == "false"
        return boolean_value(text == "true")
    if text.starts_with("[")
        string[] bag := if text == "[]" then [] else text[1:<int(#text) - 1].split(",")
        return Value("bag", bag = bag)
    if text.starts_with("-") or "0123456789".contains(text[0])
        return Value("integer", integer = int(text))
    return Value("string", text = text)

string notation(Value value)
    if value.kind == "integer"
        return "{value.integer}"
    if value.kind == "boolean"
        return if value.boolean then "true" else "false"
    if value.kind == "string"
        return DQ + value.text + DQ
    return "[" + [for item := value.bag[] then DQ + item + DQ].join(",") + "]"

map<string, Value> parse_attributes(string[] fields)
    map<string, Value> result
    for field := fields[]
        equal := 0
        while field[equal] != "="
            equal += 1
        .result.set(field[0:<int(equal)], input_value(field[int(equal) + 1:]))
    return result

Input read_input()
    input := Input()
    source := file.read("input/attributes.txt")
    while .source(string &line)
        fields := line.split(" ")
        if fields[0] == "SUBJECT"
            .input.subjects.set(fields[1], parse_attributes(fields[2:]))
        elif fields[0] == "RESOURCE"
            input.resources = input.resources.append(Resource(fields[1], fields[2], parse_attributes(fields[3:])))
        elif fields[0] == "DOMAIN"
            input.domains = input.domains.append(Domain(fields[1], [for text := fields[2:][] then input_value(text)]))
        else
            input.reference = parse_attributes(fields[1:])
    requests := file.read("input/requests.txt")
    while .requests(string &line)
        fields := line.split(" ")
        explain := fields[-1] == "EXPLAIN"
        if explain
            fields = fields[0:<int(#fields) - 1]
        input.requests = input.requests.append(Request(fields[0], fields[1], fields[2], fields[3], fields[4], parse_attributes(fields[5:]), explain))
    return input

Value boolean_fold(Value[] values, bool veto, string operation)
    reason := ""
    found := false
    for value := values[]
        if value.kind == "boolean"
            if value.boolean == veto
                found = true
        elif reason == ""
            reason = if value.kind == "error" then value.text else "type " + operation
    if found
        return boolean_value(veto)
    return if reason == "" then boolean_value(not veto) else failure(reason)

Value operation(string name, Value[] values)
    for value := values[]
        if value.kind == "error"
            return value
    first := values[0]
    if name == "not" and first.kind == "boolean"
        return boolean_value(not first.boolean)
    if name == "size" and first.kind == "bag"
        return Value("integer", integer = int(#first.bag))
    if name == "-" and #values == 1 and first.kind == "integer"
        return Value("integer", integer = -first.integer)
    if #values == 2
        second := values[1]
        if (name == "==" or name == "!=") and first.kind == second.kind and first.kind != "bag"
            equal := if first.kind == "integer" then first.integer == second.integer elif first.kind == "string" then first.text == second.text else first.boolean == second.boolean
            return boolean_value(if name == "==" then equal else not equal)
        if first.kind == "integer" and second.kind == "integer"
            a := first.integer
            b := second.integer
            if name == "+"
                return Value("integer", integer = a + b)
            if name == "-"
                return Value("integer", integer = a - b)
            if name == "*"
                return Value("integer", integer = a * b)
            if name == "<"
                return boolean_value(a < b)
            if name == "<="
                return boolean_value(a <= b)
            if name == ">"
                return boolean_value(a > b)
            if name == ">="
                return boolean_value(a >= b)
        if (name == "starts_with" or name == "^=") and first.kind == "string" and second.kind == "string"
            return boolean_value(first.text.starts_with(second.text))
        if name == "in" and first.kind == "string" and second.kind == "bag"
            contained := false
            for item := second.bag[]
                if item == first.text
                    contained = true
            return boolean_value(contained)
    return failure("type " + name)

Value expression(expressions.Tree tree, int index, map<string, Value> attributes, Value current)
    expressions.Node node := tree.nodes[index]
    name := node.operation
    if name == "integer"
        return Value("integer", integer = int(node.text))
    if name == "boolean"
        return boolean_value(node.text == "true")
    if name == "string"
        return Value("string", text = node.text)
    if name == "bag"
        return Value("bag", bag = [for child := node.children[] then tree.nodes[child].text])
    if name == "attribute"
        return lookup(attributes, node.text)
    if name == "it"
        return current
    if name == "present"
        return boolean_value(attributes.has(tree.nodes[node.children[0]].text))
    if name == "any_of" or name == "all_of"
        bag := expression(tree, node.children[0], attributes, current)
        if bag.kind == "error"
            return bag
        if bag.kind != "bag"
            return failure("type " + name)
        values := [for item := bag.bag[] then expression(tree, node.children[1], attributes, Value("string", text = item))]
        return boolean_fold(values, name == "any_of", name)
    values := [for child := node.children[] then expression(tree, child, attributes, current)]
    if name == "and" or name == "or"
        return boolean_fold(values, name == "or", name)
    return operation(name, values)

Value evaluate_expression(expressions.Tree tree, map<string, Value> attributes)
    return expression(tree, tree.root, attributes, Value("string"))

TargetResult target_group(TargetResult[] results, bool conjunction)
    veto := false
    reason := ""
    for result := results[]
        if result.state == (if conjunction then "NO_MATCH" else "MATCH")
            veto = true
        if result.state == "INDETERMINATE" and reason == ""
            reason = result.reason
    if veto
        return TargetResult(if conjunction then "NO_MATCH" else "MATCH")
    if reason != ""
        return TargetResult("INDETERMINATE", reason)
    return TargetResult(if conjunction then "MATCH" else "NO_MATCH")

TargetResult match_clause(policy_parser.Clause clause, map<string, Value> attributes)
    source := lookup(attributes, clause.reference)
    if source.kind == "error"
        return if clause.mandatory then TargetResult("INDETERMINATE", source.text) else TargetResult("NO_MATCH")
    Value[] items := if source.kind == "bag" then [for item := source.bag[] then Value("string", text = item)] else [source]
    literal := evaluate_expression(clause.literal, attributes)
    results := [for item := items[] then operation(clause.operation, [item, literal])]
    reason := ""
    matched := false
    for result := results[]
        if result.kind == "boolean" and result.boolean
            matched = true
        elif result.kind == "error" and reason == ""
            reason = result.text
    if matched
        return TargetResult()
    return if reason == "" then TargetResult("NO_MATCH") else TargetResult("INDETERMINATE", reason)

TargetResult target(policy_parser.Element element, map<string, Value> attributes)
    TargetResult[] lines := []
    for line := element.targets[]
        TargetResult[] alternatives := []
        for alternative := line.alternatives[]
            alternatives = alternatives.append(target_group([for clause := alternative[] then match_clause(clause, attributes)], true))
        lines = lines.append(target_group(alternatives, false))
    return target_group(lines, true)

void attach(policy_parser.Element element, map<string, Value> attributes, Evaluation &result)
    string effect := result.decision.name
    for: kind < 2
        policy_parser.Attachment[] definitions := if kind == 0 then element.obligations else element.advice
        for definition := definitions[]
            if definition.effect != effect
                continue
            item := definition.name
            reason := ""
            for argument := definition.arguments[]
                value := evaluate_expression(argument.expression, attributes)
                if value.kind == "error"
                    if reason == ""
                        reason = value.text
                else
                    item += " {argument.name}=" + notation(value)
            if reason != ""
                if kind == 0
                    result.decision = combining.Decision(combining.for_effect(effect), "obligation {definition.name}: {reason}")
                    result.decisive = -1
                    result.obligations = []
                    result.advice = []
                    return
                continue
            if kind == 0
                result.obligations = result.obligations.append(item)
            else
                result.advice = result.advice.append(item)

Evaluation evaluate(policy_parser.Element[] elements, int index, map<string, Value> attributes, Evaluation[] &evaluations, attachments := true)
    element := elements[index]
    result := Evaluation()
    result.state = 2
    result.target = target(element, attributes)
    if element.kind == "rule"
        if result.target.state == "INDETERMINATE"
            result.decision = combining.Decision(combining.for_effect(element.behavior), result.target.reason)
        elif result.target.state == "MATCH"
            condition := if element.condition.root < 0 then boolean_value(true) else evaluate_expression(element.condition, attributes)
            if condition.kind != "boolean" and condition.kind != "error"
                condition = failure("type condition")
            result.condition = if condition.kind == "error" then "INDETERMINATE" elif condition.boolean then "TRUE" else "FALSE"
            if condition.kind == "error"
                result.decision = combining.Decision(combining.for_effect(element.behavior), condition.text)
            elif condition.boolean
                result.decision = combining.Decision(element.behavior)
                result.decisive = index
                if attachments
                    attach(element, attributes, &result)
    elif result.target.state != "NO_MATCH"
        if element.behavior == "only-one-applicable"
            matched := -1
            stopped := false
            for child := element.children[]
                checked := target(elements[child], attributes)
                evaluations[child].state = 1
                evaluations[child].target = checked
                earlier := if matched < 0 then "" else elements[matched].name
                outcome := combining.applicability(checked.state, checked.reason, earlier, elements[child].name)
                if combining.indeterminate(outcome.name)
                    result.decision = outcome
                    stopped = true
                    break
                if checked.state == "MATCH"
                    matched = child
            if not stopped and matched >= 0
                child_result := evaluate(elements, matched, attributes, &evaluations)
                result.decision = child_result.decision
        else
            combining.Decision[] decisions := []
            for child := element.children[]
                child_result := evaluate(elements, child, attributes, &evaluations)
                decisions = decisions.append(child_result.decision)
                if combining.stop(element.behavior, child_result.decision.name)
                    break
            result.decision = combining.finish(element.behavior, decisions)
        if result.target.state == "INDETERMINATE"
            if combining.definite(result.decision.name)
                result.decision.name = combining.for_effect(result.decision.name)
            if combining.indeterminate(result.decision.name)
                result.decision.reason = result.target.reason
        if combining.definite(result.decision.name)
            result.decisive = index
            first := true
            for child := element.children[]
                supporter := evaluations[child]
                if supporter.state == 2 and supporter.decision.name == result.decision.name
                    if first
                        result.decisive = supporter.decisive
                        first = false
                    result.obligations = result.obligations.concat(supporter.obligations)
                    result.advice = result.advice.concat(supporter.advice)
            if attachments
                attach(element, attributes, &result)
    evaluations[index] = result
    return result

string[] tree_lines(policy_parser.Element[] elements, Evaluation[] evaluations, int index, int depth)
    element := elements[index]
    result := evaluations[index]
    string indent := " " * nat(2 + 2 * depth)
    line := "{indent}{element.kind} {element.name} {element.behavior} target {result.target.state}"
    if element.kind == "rule" and result.target.state == "MATCH"
        line += " condition " + result.condition
    lines := [line + " -> " + combining.notation(result.decision)]
    if element.kind != "rule" and result.target.state != "NO_MATCH"
        for child := element.children[]
            if evaluations[child].state == 2
                lines = lines.concat(tree_lines(elements, evaluations, child, depth + 1))
            elif evaluations[child].state == 0
                lines = lines.append("{indent}  {elements[child].kind} {elements[child].name} skipped")
            else
                TargetResult checked := evaluations[child].target
                suffix := if checked.state == "INDETERMINATE" then " ({checked.reason})" else ""
                lines = lines.append("{indent}  {elements[child].kind} {elements[child].name} {elements[child].behavior} target {checked.state}{suffix}")
    return lines

map<string, Value> subject_values(Input input, string user)
    match input.subjects.get(user)
        map<string, Value> values
            return values
        none
            return map<string, Value>()

void add_attributes(map<string, Value> &destination, string prefix, map<string, Value> source)
    for name := source.keys()[]
        .destination.set(prefix + name, lookup(source, name))

Checked prepare(Engine engine, Request request)
    checked := Checked()
    if not engine.inputs.subjects.has(request.user)
        checked.error_message = "unknown user " + request.user
        return checked
    for: i < int(#engine.inputs.resources)
        if engine.inputs.resources[i].name == request.resource
            checked.resource = i
            break
    if checked.resource < 0
        checked.error_message = "unknown resource " + request.resource
        return checked
    day := lookup(request.environment_values, "day")
    if day.kind != "integer" or day.integer < 1 or day.integer > 365
        checked.error_message = "bad day"
        return checked
    checked.day = day.integer
    authorized := rbac.authorized(engine.roles_data, request.user, checked.day)
    string[] candidates := if request.roles == "-" then [] elif request.roles == "*" then authorized.sorted() else request.roles.split(",")
    string[] active := []
    distinct<string> seen
    for candidate := candidates[]
        reason := ""
        if not engine.roles_data.roles.has(candidate)
            reason = "unknown"
        elif seen.has(candidate)
            reason = "duplicate"
        elif not authorized.has(candidate)
            reason = "unauthorized"
        else
            closure := rbac.closure(engine.roles_data, active.append(candidate))
            for constraint := engine.roles_data.dsd[]
                if int(#rbac.intersection(closure, constraint.roles)) >= constraint.cardinality
                    reason = "dsd " + constraint.name
                    break
        .seen.add(candidate)
        if reason == ""
            active = active.append(candidate)
        checked.activations = checked.activations.append(Activation(candidate, reason))
    checked.roles = rbac.closure(engine.roles_data, active).sorted()
    resource := engine.inputs.resources[checked.resource]
    for role := checked.roles[]
        if rbac.permits(engine.roles_data, role, request.action, resource.kind)
            checked.granting = role
            break
    add_attributes(&checked.attributes, "subject.", subject_values(engine.inputs, request.user))
    .checked.attributes.set("subject.id", Value("string", text = request.user))
    .checked.attributes.set("subject.role", Value("bag", bag = checked.roles))
    .checked.attributes.set("subject.rbac", boolean_value(checked.granting != ""))
    add_attributes(&checked.attributes, "resource.", resource.attributes)
    .checked.attributes.set("resource.id", Value("string", text = resource.name))
    .checked.attributes.set("resource.type", Value("string", text = resource.kind))
    .checked.attributes.set("action.id", Value("string", text = request.action))
    add_attributes(&checked.attributes, "environment.", request.environment_values)
    checked.evaluations = [for element := engine.elements[] then Evaluation()]
    root := evaluate(engine.elements, 0, checked.attributes, &checked.evaluations)
    return checked

string final_notation(Engine engine, Evaluation result)
    text := combining.notation(result.decision)
    if combining.definite(result.decision.name)
        text += " by " + engine.elements[result.decisive].name
    return text

int count_value(map<string, int> table, string key)
    match table.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

int decisive_count(Engine engine, int index)
    match engine.decisive.get(index)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

int grant_count(Engine engine, rbac.Grant grant)
    match engine.grants.get((grant.role, grant.action, grant.resource_type))
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

void process_requests(Engine &engine)
    for request := engine.inputs.requests[]
        checked := prepare(engine, request)
        explanation := ["request " + request.name]
        if checked.error_message != ""
            engine.decision_lines = engine.decision_lines.append("{request.name} ERROR {checked.error_message}")
            .engine.decisions.increment("ERROR")
            explanation = explanation.append("  error " + checked.error_message)
        else
            root := checked.evaluations[0]
            result := final_notation(engine, root)
            engine.decision_lines = engine.decision_lines.append("{request.name} {result}")
            resource := engine.inputs.resources[checked.resource]
            explanation = explanation.append("  user {request.user} resource {resource.name} type {resource.kind} action {request.action} day {checked.day}")
            for activation := checked.activations[]
                if activation.reason != ""
                    engine.refused += 1
                    engine.decision_lines = engine.decision_lines.append("  refused {activation.role} {activation.reason}")
                suffix := if activation.reason == "" then "ok" else "refused " + activation.reason
                explanation = explanation.append("  activate {activation.role} {suffix}")
            explanation = explanation.append("  roles " + (if #checked.roles == 0 then "-" else checked.roles.join(",")))
            explanation = explanation.append("  rbac " + (if checked.granting == "" then "no" else "yes " + checked.granting))
            explanation = explanation.concat(tree_lines(engine.elements, checked.evaluations, 0, 0)).append("  decision " + result)
            for item := root.obligations[]
                engine.decision_lines = engine.decision_lines.append("  obligation " + item)
                .engine.obligations.increment(item.split(" ")[0])
            for item := root.advice[]
                engine.decision_lines = engine.decision_lines.append("  advice " + item)
                .engine.advice.increment(item.split(" ")[0])
            if checked.granting != ""
                .engine.grants.increment((checked.granting, request.action, resource.kind))
            .engine.decisions.increment(if combining.indeterminate(root.decision.name) then "INDETERMINATE" else root.decision.name)
            if combining.definite(root.decision.name)
                .engine.decisive.increment(root.decisive)
        for: index < int(#engine.elements)
            if engine.elements[index].kind != "rule"
                continue
            symbol := "."
            if checked.error_message == "" and checked.evaluations[index].state == 2
                string decision := checked.evaluations[index].decision.name
                symbol = if decision == "PERMIT" then "P" elif decision == "DENY" then "D" elif decision == "NOT_APPLICABLE" then "-" else "I"
            engine.coverage[index] += symbol
        if request.explain
            if #engine.trace_lines > 0
                engine.trace_lines = engine.trace_lines.append("")
            engine.trace_lines = engine.trace_lines.concat(explanation)

bool any_day(bool[] days)
    for included := days[]
        if included
            return true
    return false

string[] permission_report(Engine engine)
    distinct<string> users
    for assignment := engine.roles_data.assignments[]
        .users.add(assignment.user)
    roles := engine.roles_data.roles.sorted()
    string[] lines := []
    for user := users.sorted()[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.append("user " + user)
        assignments := [for role := roles[] then array(nat(366), fill = false)]
        authorizations := [for role := roles[] then array(nat(366), fill = false)]
        for assignment := engine.roles_data.assignments[]
            if assignment.user != user
                continue
            closure := rbac.closure(engine.roles_data, [assignment.role])
            for: index < int(#roles)
                for: assignment.first <= int day <= assignment.last
                    if roles[index] == assignment.role
                        assignments[index][day] = true
                    if closure.has(roles[index])
                        authorizations[index][day] = true
        for: index < int(#roles)
            if any_day(assignments[index])
                lines = lines.append("  assigned {roles[index]} " + analysis.day_notation(assignments[index]))
        for: index < int(#roles)
            if any_day(authorizations[index])
                lines = lines.append("  authorized {roles[index]} " + analysis.day_notation(authorizations[index]))
        distinct<string> pairs
        for: index < int(#roles)
            if any_day(authorizations[index])
                for grant := engine.roles_data.grants[]
                    if grant.role == roles[index]
                        .pairs.add("{grant.action} {grant.resource_type}")
        for pair := pairs.sorted()[]
            fields := pair.split(" ")
            string[] via := []
            days := array(nat(366), fill = false)
            for: index < int(#roles)
                if any_day(authorizations[index]) and rbac.permits(engine.roles_data, roles[index], fields[0], fields[1])
                    via = via.append(roles[index])
                    for: 1 <= day <= 365
                        days[day] = days[day] or authorizations[index][day]
            effective := "-"
            if engine.inputs.subjects.has(user)
                resources := 0
                permits := 0
                for resource := engine.inputs.resources[]
                    if resource.kind != fields[1]
                        continue
                    resources += 1
                    request := Request("", user, "*", fields[0], resource.name, engine.inputs.reference, false)
                    checked := prepare(engine, request)
                    if checked.evaluations[0].decision.name == "PERMIT"
                        permits += 1
                effective = "{permits}/{resources}"
            lines = lines.append("  permission {pair} " + analysis.day_notation(days) + " via " + via.join(",") + " effective " + effective)
    return lines

string[] domain_analysis(Engine engine)
    count := int(#engine.elements)
    rules := [for index := (0:<count)[] if engine.elements[index].kind == "rule" then index]
    applications := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    examples := array(nat(count), fill = "-")
    shadowed := array(nat(count), fill = true)
    blockers := [for i := (0:<count)[] then distinct<int>()]
    conflicts := [for i := (0:<count)[] then array(nat(count), fill = 0)]
    points := analysis.points([for domain := engine.inputs.domains[] then int(#domain.values)])
    for point := points[]
        map<string, Value> values
        string[] example := []
        for: dimension < int(#point)
            domain := engine.inputs.domains[dimension]
            value := domain.values[point[dimension]]
            .values.set(domain.name, value)
            if #domain.values >= 2
                example = example.append(domain.name + "=" + notation(value))
        standalone := array(nat(count), fill = "NOT_APPLICABLE")
        applying := array(nat(count), fill = false)
        for index := rules[]
            scratch := [for i := (0:<count)[] then Evaluation()]
            rule := evaluate(engine.elements, index, values, &scratch, false)
            standalone[index] = rule.decision.name
        for index := rules[]
            ancestors_match := true
            parent := engine.elements[index].parent
            while parent >= 0
                if target(engine.elements[parent], values).state != "MATCH"
                    ancestors_match = false
                parent = engine.elements[parent].parent
            if not ancestors_match or not combining.definite(standalone[index])
                continue
            applying[index] = true
            applications[index] += 1
            if applications[index] == 1
                examples[index] = example.join(" ")
            policy := engine.elements[engine.elements[index].parent]
            if policy.behavior != "first-applicable"
                shadowed[index] = false
            else
                int[] earlier := []
                for child := policy.children[]
                    if child == index
                        break
                    earlier = earlier.append(child)
                blocker := analysis.blocker(earlier, standalone)
                if blocker < 0
                    shadowed[index] = false
                else
                    .blockers[index].add(blocker)
        for policy := engine.elements[]
            if policy.kind != "policy"
                continue
            for: i < int(#policy.children)
                first := policy.children[i]
                for: i + 1 <= j < int(#policy.children)
                    second := policy.children[j]
                    if applying[first] and applying[second] and engine.elements[first].behavior != engine.elements[second].behavior
                        conflicts[first][second] += 1
    lines := ["applicability {#points}"]
    for index := rules[]
        lines = lines.append("  {engine.elements[index].name} {applications[index]} {examples[index]}")
    dead := [for index := rules[] if applications[index] == 0 then index]
    lines = lines.append("dead {#dead}")
    for index := dead[]
        lines = lines.append("  " + engine.elements[index].name)
    hidden := [for index := rules[] if applications[index] > 0 and shadowed[index] then index]
    lines = lines.append("shadowed {#hidden}")
    for index := hidden[]
        names := [for blocker := blockers[index].sorted()[] then engine.elements[blocker].name]
        lines = lines.append("  {engine.elements[index].name} by " + names.join(","))
    string[] conflict_lines := []
    for policy := engine.elements[]
        if policy.kind != "policy"
            continue
        for: i < int(#policy.children)
            first := policy.children[i]
            for: i + 1 <= j < int(#policy.children)
                second := policy.children[j]
                total := conflicts[first][second]
                if total > 0
                    winner := analysis.conflict_winner(policy.behavior, first, second, engine.elements[first].behavior)
                    conflict_lines = conflict_lines.append("  {policy.name} {engine.elements[first].name} {engine.elements[second].name} {total} {engine.elements[winner].name}")
    return lines.append("conflicts {#conflict_lines}").concat(conflict_lines)

string[] analysis_report(Engine engine)
    lines := ["rbac {#engine.roles_data.diagnostics}"]
    for diagnostic := engine.roles_data.diagnostics[]
        lines = lines.append("  line {diagnostic.line} {diagnostic.keyword} {diagnostic.message}")
    lines = lines.append("grants {#engine.roles_data.grants}")
    rbac.Grant[] grants := engine.roles_data.grants.sorted(by = ([for grant := engine.roles_data.grants[] then grant.role], [for grant := engine.roles_data.grants[] then grant.action], [for grant := engine.roles_data.grants[] then grant.resource_type]))
    for grant := grants[]
        lines = lines.append("  {grant.role} {grant.action} {grant.resource_type} {grant_count(engine, grant)}")
    lines = lines.concat(domain_analysis(engine))
    lines = lines.append("coverage {#engine.inputs.requests}")
    string[] uncovered := []
    for: index < int(#engine.elements)
        if engine.elements[index].kind != "rule"
            continue
        symbols := engine.coverage[index]
        covered := 0
        for: i < int(#symbols)
            if symbols[i] == "P" or symbols[i] == "D"
                covered += 1
        lines = lines.append("  {engine.elements[index].name} {symbols} {covered}")
        if covered == 0
            uncovered = uncovered.append("  " + engine.elements[index].name)
    lines = lines.append("uncovered {#uncovered}").concat(uncovered).append("summary")
    for name := ["PERMIT", "DENY", "NOT_APPLICABLE", "INDETERMINATE", "ERROR"][]
        lines = lines.append("  decision {name} {count_value(engine.decisions, name)}")
    lines = lines.append("  refused {engine.refused}")
    for: index < int(#engine.elements)
        total := decisive_count(engine, index)
        if total > 0
            lines = lines.append("  decisive {engine.elements[index].name} {total}")
    for name := engine.obligations.keys().sorted()[]
        lines = lines.append("  obligation {name} {count_value(engine.obligations, name)}")
    for name := engine.advice.keys().sorted()[]
        lines = lines.append("  advice {name} {count_value(engine.advice, name)}")
    return lines

void write_lines(string filename, string[] lines)
    destination := file.write("output/" + filename)
    if #lines > 0
        .destination(lines.join(NL) + NL)

void run_program()
    engine := Engine(rbac.read_rbac(), policy_parser.read_policies(), read_input())
    process_requests(&engine)
    if not file.exists("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    write_lines("decisions.txt", engine.decision_lines)
    write_lines("traces.txt", engine.trace_lines)
    write_lines("permissions.txt", permission_report(engine))
    write_lines("analysis.txt", analysis_report(engine))

run_program()

import expressions = "./expressions.qui"

class Clause(string reference, bool mandatory, string operation, expressions.Tree literal)
class Target(Clause[][] alternatives)
class Argument(string name, expressions.Tree expression)
class Attachment(string effect, string name, Argument[] arguments)
class Element(string kind, string name, string behavior, int parent)
    Target[] targets := []
    int[] children := []
    condition := expressions.Tree([], -1)
    Attachment[] obligations := []
    Attachment[] advice := []

Target parse_target(string text)
    Clause[][] alternatives := []
    for alternative := text.split(" | ")[]
        Clause[] clauses := []
        for clause := alternative.split(" & ")[]
            fields := clause.split(" ")
            reference := fields[0]
            mandatory := reference.ends_with("!")
            if mandatory
                reference = reference[0:<int(#reference) - 1]
            clauses = clauses.append(Clause(reference, mandatory, fields[1], expressions.parse(fields[2])))
        alternatives = alternatives.append(clauses)
    return Target(alternatives)

Element[] read_policies()
    Element[] elements := []
    int[] stack := []
    source := file.read("input/policies.txt")
    while .source(string &raw)
        string line := raw.trim()
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        words := line.split(" ")
        keyword := words[0]
        if keyword == "POLICYSET" or keyword == "POLICY" or keyword == "RULE"
            parent := if #stack == 0 then -1 else stack[-1]
            index := int(#elements)
            elements = elements.append(Element(keyword.lower_ascii(), words[1], words[2], parent))
            if parent >= 0
                elements[parent].children = elements[parent].children.append(index)
            stack = stack.append(index)
        elif keyword == "END"
            stack = stack[0:<int(#stack) - 1]
        else
            index := stack[-1]
            rest := line[int(#keyword) + 1:]
            if keyword == "TARGET"
                elements[index].targets = elements[index].targets.append(parse_target(rest))
            elif keyword == "CONDITION"
                elements[index].condition = expressions.parse(rest)
            else
                effect := words[1]
                name := words[2]
                Argument[] arguments := []
                offset := int(#keyword + #effect + #name) + 3
                if offset < int(#line)
                    for part := line[offset:].split(";")[]
                        string clean := part.trim()
                        equal := 0
                        while clean[equal] != "="
                            equal += 1
                        arguments = arguments.append(Argument(clean[0:<int(equal)], expressions.parse(clean[int(equal) + 1:])))
                attachment := Attachment(effect, name, arguments)
                if keyword == "OBLIGATION"
                    elements[index].obligations = elements[index].obligations.append(attachment)
                else
                    elements[index].advice = elements[index].advice.append(attachment)
    return elements

class Grant(string role, string action, string resource_type)
class Constraint(string name, int cardinality, string[] roles)
class Assignment(string user, string role, int first, int last)
class Diagnostic(int line, string keyword, string message)
class RBAC()
    roles := distinct<string>()
    inherits := map<string, string[]>()
    Grant[] grants := []
    Constraint[] ssd := []
    Constraint[] dsd := []
    Assignment[] assignments := []
    Diagnostic[] diagnostics := []

string[] juniors(RBAC data, string role)
    match data.inherits.get(role)
        string[] values
            return values
        none
            return []

distinct<string> closure(RBAC data, string[] seeds)
    distinct<string> reached
    string[] pending := []
    for role := seeds[]
        if not reached.has(role)
            .reached.add(role)
            pending = pending.append(role)
    index := 0
    while index < int(#pending)
        role := pending[index]
        index += 1
        for junior := juniors(data, role)[]
            if not reached.has(junior)
                .reached.add(junior)
                pending = pending.append(junior)
    return reached

string[] inheritance_path(RBAC data, string start, string finish)
    if start == finish
        return [start]
    for junior := juniors(data, start).sorted()[]
        suffix := inheritance_path(data, junior, finish)
        if #suffix > 0
            return [start].concat(suffix)
    return []

distinct<string> assigned(RBAC data, string user, int day)
    distinct<string> result
    for assignment := data.assignments[]
        if assignment.user == user and assignment.first <= day and day <= assignment.last
            .result.add(assignment.role)
    return result

distinct<string> authorized(RBAC data, string user, int day)
    return closure(data, assigned(data, user, day).values())

string[] intersection(distinct<string> roles, string[] candidates)
    string[] result := []
    for candidate := candidates[]
        if roles.has(candidate)
            result = result.append(candidate)
    return result.sorted()

bool permits(RBAC data, string role, string action, string resource_type)
    for grant := data.grants[]
        if grant.role == role and grant.action == action and grant.resource_type == resource_type
            return true
    return false

string accept(RBAC &data, string[] fields)
    keyword := fields[0]
    if keyword == "ROLE"
        if data.roles.has(fields[1])
            return "duplicate role " + fields[1]
        .data.roles.add(fields[1])
        .data.inherits.set(fields[1], [])
    elif keyword == "INHERITS"
        senior := fields[1]
        junior := fields[2]
        for role := [senior, junior][]
            if not data.roles.has(role)
                return "unknown role " + role
        for existing := juniors(data, senior)[]
            if existing == junior
                return "duplicate inheritance {senior} {junior}"
        if closure(data, [junior]).has(senior)
            return "cycle " + [senior].concat(inheritance_path(data, junior, senior)).join(" > ")
        .data.inherits.set(senior, juniors(data, senior).append(junior))
    elif keyword == "PERMIT"
        role := fields[1]
        if not data.roles.has(role)
            return "unknown role " + role
        if permits(data, role, fields[2], fields[3])
            return "duplicate permission {role} {fields[2]} {fields[3]}"
        data.grants = data.grants.append(Grant(role, fields[2], fields[3]))
    elif keyword == "SSD" or keyword == "DSD"
        existing := if keyword == "SSD" then data.ssd else data.dsd
        for constraint := existing[]
            if constraint.name == fields[1]
                return "duplicate constraint " + fields[1]
        roles := fields[3].split(",")
        for role := roles[]
            if not data.roles.has(role)
                return "unknown role " + role
        cardinality := int(fields[2])
        if cardinality < 2 or cardinality > int(#roles)
            return "bad cardinality {fields[1]} {cardinality}"
        constraint := Constraint(fields[1], cardinality, roles)
        if keyword == "SSD"
            data.ssd = data.ssd.append(constraint)
        else
            data.dsd = data.dsd.append(constraint)
    else
        user := fields[1]
        role := fields[2]
        first := int(fields[3])
        last := int(fields[4])
        if not data.roles.has(role)
            return "unknown role " + role
        if first < 1 or first > last or last > 365
            return "bad range {first} {last}"
        for constraint := data.ssd[]
            for: first <= day <= last
                candidates := assigned(data, user, day).values().append(role)
                common := intersection(closure(data, candidates), constraint.roles)
                if int(#common) >= constraint.cardinality
                    return "ssd {constraint.name} day {day} roles " + common.join(",")
        data.assignments = data.assignments.append(Assignment(user, role, first, last))
    return ""

RBAC read_rbac()
    data := RBAC()
    string[][] rows := []
    source := file.read("input/rbac.txt")
    while .source(string &line)
        rows = rows.append(line.split(" "))
    for keyword := ["ROLE", "INHERITS", "PERMIT", "SSD", "DSD", "ASSIGN"][]
        for: index < int(#rows)
            if rows[index][0] == keyword
                message := accept(&data, rows[index])
                if message != ""
                    data.diagnostics = data.diagnostics.append(Diagnostic(index + 1, keyword, message))
    order := [for diagnostic := data.diagnostics[] then diagnostic.line]
    data.diagnostics = data.diagnostics.sorted(by = order)
    return data
